# Nyaya Mitra

> Scenario-first legal triage for everyday legal problems in India. Describe what
> happened in plain language and get your options, your deadlines, and a clear
> answer on whether you need a lawyer.

Nyaya Mitra provides general legal information about Indian law. It is not a
lawyer and does not give legal advice. Criminal defence, family and custody
matters, immigration, and anything already before a court are out of scope and
are routed to a qualified professional.

Legal content comes from hand-written Situation Playbooks, not from a language
model. The model only classifies a described situation and extracts facts the
user stated; it never supplies statutes, deadlines or recommendations.

## Situations covered

Renting a home: deposit withheld; eviction, lockout or essential supplies cut
off; repairs the landlord will not carry out.

Society and builders: a housing society or RWA charging arbitrarily, withholding
an NOC or denying facilities; a builder delaying possession of a booked flat.

Work and employers: unpaid salary or dues; unfair dismissal; relieving letter,
experience certificate or Form 16 withheld, including training bonds; provident
fund deducted but not deposited.

Also: a faulty purchase where a refund is refused; an unauthorised transaction on
a bank account; a bounced cheque.

## Documentation

- [Source and README](https://github.com/vinamravinay12/nyaya-mitra): overview, approach, assumptions and known gaps
- [Architecture](https://github.com/vinamravinay12/nyaya-mitra/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the engine and its trust boundaries work
- [Decision records](https://github.com/vinamravinay12/nyaya-mitra/blob/main/docs/decisions.md): what was decided, and what each decision cost
- [Security](https://github.com/vinamravinay12/nyaya-mitra/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): credential handling, untrusted input, supply chain
